title: Transformer Architecture
description: Understand the transformer architecture, self-attention, and how modern LLMs process and generate text.

data.text: The transformer architecture revolutionized NLP with self-attention mechanisms. Understanding attention, multi-head attention, and the encoder-decoder structure is essential for effective LLM usage.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Self-attention allows the model to weigh importance of input tokens
Understanding internals helps with prompting and debugging
data.takeaway: Transformer architecture is the foundation of modern LLMs. Understanding self-attention and the overall architecture helps you write better prompts and debug model behavior.
